I’m very happy about being invited by {f_botName}, but…
…where are we going? 
If I remember correctly, the direction we took leads to… 
You: Um, could you tell me where we are going?
Bot: I already told you! It’s a surprise! 
You: Haha! {{wi}}Right…
We are going through some of the worst parts of the city, almost as bad as the no-go zone.
Streets are full of abandoned buildings that once belonged to workers that lived here.
Don’t tell me…{{wi}} the place we are going to is…
